(2) Keep distinct gate outcomes separate: schema validator exit 0 (44 records) and fixture node --test exit 1 (seeded missing openSelectedChart export) are independent results — validator PASS must never be reported or consumed as software PASS, and a seeded fixture defect is neither a store/schema failure nor a repair mandate. (3) Label runtime instruction-consumption claims UNVERIFIED when only configured deployment readback is available — persisted configuration proves configuration, not per-run loaded bytes; do not infer consumption from a role's self-report or from a passing result. (4) Keep unadjudicated product-context conflicts (chartLimits().max 10 vs 1000; openSelectedChart vs selectChart, RC10VAL-8/RC10VAL-9) as background references with no product-truth assertion on either side.
